title: The Mercury Theatre on the Air
paragraphs: Frozen GRH row is an Orson Welles radio archive container, not a single 1938-1950 series. Only 18 objects belong to Mercury Theatre on the Air proper; later items are separately profiled by historical program.

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are [[person|orson-welles|Orson Welles]] (performer on 14 recordings, host on 5 recordings, radio adaptor on 2 recordings, director on 2 recordings, and producer on 1 recording), Bernard Herrmann (conductor on 15 recordings, composer on 12 recordings, and music on 1 recording), Ray Collins (performer on 12 recordings and narrator on 4 recordings), Dan Seymour (announcer on 11 recordings and performer on 4 recordings), Edgar Barrier (performer on 9 recordings), George Coulouris (performer on 9 recordings), and Eustace Wyatt (performer on 8 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.b1c76a6702c1bee9|WABC]] (aircheck from station), [[org|org.f8fbca558a370a00|WBT]] (aircheck from station), and [[org|org.9cc47908c68e2d15|WRVA]] (aircheck from station).
Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include literary adaptation, war and military service, horror and supernatural, and aviation.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Mercury Theatre on the Air launch, War of the Worlds broadcast, Campbell Playhouse transition, and Ceiling Unlimited wartime aviation series.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]] (33 shared credited people), [[show|the-shadow|The Shadow]] (14 shared credited people), [[show|cbs-radio-mystery-theater|CBS Radio Mystery Theater]] (14 shared credited people), [[show|suspense|Suspense]] (7 shared credited people), and [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]] (6 shared credited people).
